name: Festival Utsava
description: You returned to Vanarana with Arama after parting with Arana and Rana. It's finally time for Festival Utsava.

steps.description: Enjoy Festival Utsava with Aranara in the Vanarana in the dream
Play a melody by the stage
Head to Araja's house to rest
Head to Araja's house to rest

dialogs.content: We're back, Araja!
Finally! Everyone's been waiting!
Festival Utsava has started, but it's not in full swing yet since Nara friends didn't get back till now.
There are so many Aranara here.
#It's been a real grind adventuring like this huh. Let's just enjoy the festivities right now, {NICKNAME}!
#Yes, you must enjoy yourselves, Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon.
Yes. I'll see you later.
Can we prepare the Bija once the festival is over?
As far as I know, yes.
Hey, it's the Golden Nara! Perfect timing!
#My name is {NICKNAME}...
Gold is a wonderful color, the same as sunshine. That's what I'd like to call you on this important occasion!
#Regardless, your name shall be recorded in our songs. Nara {NICKNAME} is a good name, very lyrical!
#"The {M#boy}{F#girl} whose eyes and soul are as golden as the sun, thy name is Nara {NICKNAME}."
Hey, what about Paimon? Don't forget Paimon now!
"The pearl in moonlight, pure as silver, thy name is Paimon..."
Yes, Paimon wants to hear more! Maybe something that lauds our friendship too...
Back to the topic...
#Nara {NICKNAME}! Paimon!
You're here! Everybody's having a great time at the festival.
#It's always nice to have someone to help out and play with, right, {NICKNAME}?
That's right!
#No, not in that way! We're happy because we made friends with Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon.
Although Aranakin, Aranaga, and Aragaru don't remember you, the forest does. The story will live on.
Yeah, the singing of a Nara friend with Aranara is the most important part of the festival in the story! Song gatherers, are you ready?
"From the first cry after birth, this is the moment you've been preparing for..."
Stupid Arayasa, only baby Nara are born and would cry.
We're ready! And so is the ancient "stage" where it will take place!
It was Aramuhukunda before me, and there will be other song gatherers after me to make it grow. It's been waiting for a long time to hear the duet between Nara and Aranara again.
#I'm very much looking forward to it as well. Are you ready, Nara {NICKNAME}?
#According to how it was done before, you should be playing instruments too, right? Paimon can't wait for your performance, {NICKNAME}!
I'm ready.
Don't worry, just use the instrument you're used to and play it at your own pace.
Well then, Golden Nara, we shall sing together! Please take the lead!
#Go, Nara {NICKNAME}!
I'm a bit nervous...
#Huh. Even someone as mighty as Nara {NICKNAME} can get nervous?
Oh.
(Wait for more.)
"Gold and silver, the colors of the sun and moon, are the reflection of their friendship."
Not bad! Adding a few lines praising Paimon's wisdom would be nice, too!
Let's not digress further...
(Wait for more.)
"The paths of stars, of flowing water, are all an open aranyaka to the silver one. The riddle is the moonlight's bait, the wisdom is the pearl's glimmer."
Very poetic! Y'know, Paimon's also very brave... sooo, get Paimon's drift?
That's enough, Paimon.
(Wait for more.)
"Swelling like a specter, surging ahead like a boar..."
Hey, who are you calling a Specter? What a letdown!
Don't you know my name?
The Aranara disperse following the duet.
Wow, that was great! Your playing and the Aranara song were both awesome!
#Yeah, Nara {NICKNAME} is awesome! I'd love to travel with you and remember your songs!
Thanks.
#Such a radiant melody. How exciting! Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon, and your song... What an epic tale!
Not calling me "Golden Nara" anymore?
I'm short on experience, but if the stories were true, the glow from Nara Varuna's song might have been dimmer than yours!
#Aradasa is right. Please take these as tokens of our appreciation, Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon.
Whoa, this is a lot of flowers...
"Even though the horizon is so gray, it's such a blessing to meet you..."
"...Singing your song forever is the pact between you and me."
Thank you. I'll cherish your gift.
#Thank you, Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon.
Paimon guesses that Festival Utsava is coming to an end...
And we're one step closer to getting the Bija.
We should ask Araja what to do next... Hey, where did Araja and Arama go?
Oh, they went that way after the duet.
Let's go over there.
#I do want to tell Nara {NICKNAME} that...
#Arasudraka has learned why Nara {NICKNAME} entered Vanarana. Your and Arana's friend will be fine.
Also, no matter how dark the sky and land get, as long as your spirit emits warmth like a golden sun, there will always be hope.
I understand. Thank you.
#Don't worry, Arasudraka! {NICKNAME} has always been like that!
We'll get going now. Farewell!
Farewell!
Gotcha.
Thank you, and farewell.
Finally, light at the end of the tunnel.
We must help Rana.
I accept your gift.
It's a good thing that no Whopperflowers showed up.
Aranara are very impressive.
The last Festival Utsava took place during Nara Varuna's time! In many tales and recollections, Marana was everywhere back then.
Trees died, and lush plains turned brown. It rained filthy red water... Red, not the lovely apple red. Very horrifying!
I'm glad I don't remember it now. Many children returned to Sarva before they were done growing into Vasara Trees. But there were still Nara Varuna and Festival Utsava.
Yes. At the time, you must have been a young Aranara sapling like me!
#Right. I have lost a lot of memories, but still can recall Nara's tears. Salty drops fell from {M#her}{F#his} eyes, but I wasn't afraid.
#{M#She}{F#He} spoke to me at length about our adventures in the forest, and thus the tales were preserved. Then, {M#she}{F#he} left.
#I wonder where {M#she}{F#he} is now? {M#She}{F#He} was very much like you, Nara {NICKNAME}. You two might be Nara, but you are shining like the warm, golden sun.
Drifting seeds are destined to flourish on nice soil... same for Nara! One day, the wind in Nara's hearts will stop, halting their steps.
#But Nara {NICKNAME} is not like ordinary Nara. Nara {NICKNAME} will keep traveling, and will perhaps run into Nara Varuna someday!
Yes, but you forgot, Arama, that Nara are not Aranara. Their time is short.
Nara Varuna couldn't live as long as trees, nor share dreams and memories as we do. How lonely and lamentable the Nara are.
#...Right. If only Nara {NICKNAME} were an Aranara! If so, we would've known each other from way before and shared so many memories.
The forest will remember. I'll bring all of Vanarana's memories to meet Aramuhukunda in Sarva, like rivers converging into the sea.
A very long time ago, Vanarana was destroyed in that Nara catastrophe. Since then, Aranara made dreams their home and distanced themselves from Nara.
Only Nara Varuna has always been friends with Aranara and continued helping everyone after the destruction. Only then did Aranara trust Nara again, little by little.
#When we parted, {M#she}{F#he} told me that, maybe one day, another Golden Nara would come to us, and {M#he}{F#she} would bring us even better memories.
#I think that with you and Nara {NICKNAME}, perhaps it's time for us to walk, sing, and play with Nara in the forests once again.
#But everybody trusts Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon because they're genuinely good. It wouldn't be a problem if all Nara are nice like Nara {NICKNAME} and Nara Varuna!
You sound like an old Nara, Araja!
Oh, I'm very happy to have the festival and give the flowers to the Golden Nara, but I'm also reminded of a lot of other things...
Arama, Araja! What are you doing here?
#Don't tell Paimon you ran away because you didn't like how {NICKNAME} played?
#No! Nara {NICKNAME}'s performance was a bright ray of sunshine. It felt very, very good.
#But the Bija is crucial to Arana's and Nara {NICKNAME}'s wish, so I had to get ready.
Oh yeah, the Bija...
Right!
I went looking for the Fane of Ashvattha right after the song ended.
That sounds like it had something to do with the concourses we visited before.
Paimon is as bright as moonlight. That's where Ashvattha's Tree of Dreams is. It's an ancient, sturdy Vasara Tree that's able to produce Bija.
However, I don't remember the location, nor am I able to leave Vanarana's dream, so it's all up to Arama to find it.
#Worry not. Like Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon would say, "I got this!"
You got this!
Paimon's confused. You said that you can't leave, Araja. Can't you go to places in a jiffy like Arama?
I've been limited to moving only in Vanarana's dreams since a long, long time ago.
A "Tree of Dreams" is required to anchor a dream this big, and I became that tree so everyone would have a home.
How can this be...
What's the matter, Paimon? It's a good thing for me to house so many big dreams and be with everyone.
Yeah, I want to be a great Aranara like Araja when I grow up, hosting many dreams like a tree with many leaves!
Aranara have a different way of thinking...
Uh... Paimon gets it...
Well, that eccentric Aranara we met before also said that Bija is yielded from the extraction of memories and dreams.
Is that true? Can Aranara lose their memory?
That's probably the case... but I can no longer recall it now.
So what should we do now?
#You got a lot of flowers during the festival, right, Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon?
Not just during the festival! We got some from Aranakin, Aragaru, and Aranaga too...
Paimon wishes they could remember all the adventures we had together...
Don't worry, no memories will be lost! The forest will remember, just like the rivers emptying into the sea, before being turned into the rain splashing down unto the earth.
#Give me all the flowers, Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon!
Okay.
They're mementos of Aranara's friendship and are precious to us. What do you need them for, Arama?
I'm putting my flowers and theirs together!
Since you put it that way, Arama...
You hand Arama all of the flowers.
Arama weaves a garland out of the flowers, including its own, and puts it on your head.
This is...
#Oh, it's so pretty. It looks great on you, Nara {NICKNAME}!
This garland represents the blessings that we Aranara, as well as all of Vanarana, want to bestow upon our favorite Nara.
Unlike you Nara, we Aranara can communicate in our dreams.
Any sadness can be shared among all Aranara to soften its blow, and we share our joys as well.
#When Nara {NICKNAME} wears the garland, we'll be able to share the load on your mind, and we can protect you when you have nightmares.
Thank you.
#I should be thanking you, Nara {NICKNAME}, for accepting our flowers! That gives us greater joy than soaking in the sun, drinking sweet water, and dreaming nice things.
Paimon wants a garland too!
I doubt that's necessary.
Huh? Why not?
#Nara {NICKNAME} will be facing many great dangers and experiencing great sadness. We can ward off some of {M#his}{F#her} nightmares through the garland.
#On the other hand, Nara {NICKNAME} will protect Paimon from nightmares. You will always be together and will share both joy and sorrow.
That's right. We're the best of friends, after all!
So what should we do now?
We're going to offer the Vasoma Fruit at the Fane of Ashvattha. Then we can produce the Bija with Arana!
I have studied you Nara before. Unlike Aranara, you have to "sleep" when the moon is up, and you come out only after the sun has risen.
#Would you like to sleep, Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon?
Now that you mention it, Paimon's pretty bushed from all the fun today.
You can rest in my house, if you'd like. Vanarana will guard your dreams.
I'll take the offer. I'm feeling rather tired.
Well, since Paimon's exhausted...
I'll accept it.
#Thank you, Nara {NICKNAME}, for accepting our flowers! That gives us greater joy than soaking in the sun, drinking sweet water, and dreaming nice things.
No way!
We met an odd Aranara once...
Yes. It said that Bija is yielded from the extraction of memories and dreams.
Araja, what do you mean you "can't leave"...?
I totally didn't forget that, ahaha...
#Paimon blames it on Festival Utsava feast that {NICKNAME} made. It was so delicious that Paimon got distracted.
Actually, I've been wanting to ask you something. Why do Nara sleep?
Because it brings us comfort.
I see! Aranara "hibernate" only when a great, great danger is present. We turn into tiny seeds and go into dreamless slumbers.
But we will be isolated from others, and that's rather scary. Not to mention having to accumulate a lot of memories to change back into our previous forms...
But you Nara are different. You must sleep often, and that's the only way you can dream. Dreams are precious, so I understand... But it is strange. You have had very few dreams lately, big Nara...
Regardless, you can sleep here without worries. We will guard your dreams and stop bad things like Vanagni from getting in.
Sounds good, but...

Gah, you and your mentions of dreams... Paimon almost feels like meeting you and spending the festival with you might just all be a dream Paimon had after eating those mushrooms, and that all this will vanish once Paimon wakes up...
Will we still see you when we wake up?
Of course!
Good night, Paimon.
Good night!
See you tomorrow, Arama.
Farewell!
I don't know. I think sleeping is a waste of time.
#Eh? Don't you think sleep is pretty comfortable, {NICKNAME}?
Oh my, I am so happy! I hope you will be happy too. Our greatest wish during Festival Utsava is to see our Nara friends happy.
Nara time is much more precious than Aranara time, so I will not keep you from enjoying yourselves. Go look for Arakavi later. He is also preparing for the Festival Utsava ceremony.
The last time we had such a lively Festival Utsava was when Nara Varuna came to Vanarana...
The festival may be fun, but nothing lasts forever.
Just like how Nilotpala Lotuses in the water never stay in bloom. They must always close sometime.
#This feels just like the time Nara Varuna celebrated Festival Utsava with Aranara all over again... Aranakula hasn't been so happy in a very long time, Nara {NICKNAME}. *sob*
Viparyas hate tears. Festival Utsava is a happy festival. Aranakula will play a happy song for Viparyas!
Hehe, Festival Utsava, so lively! Vanarana is filled with joy!
But Festival Utsava will end. Nara friends of Aranara might leave too.
The forest will remember.
The forest will remember, but...
I pray that no wind shall blow away our happiness; that there shall be rain to wet the earth and keep our Nara friends a while longer...
#Thank you, Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon, for coming to Vanarana and celebrating Festival Utsava with us Aranara.
Ararycan wants to spend more time together with you, good friends...
Nara's "taste of happiness" is so strange... But since Nara is happy, Arapacati and her brothers shall be happy too!
The "taste of happiness" is good, of course. B—But it's not just about the sugar.
The Head Mushroom helped too! The Head Mushroom I've always dreamed about! Its aroma... Ahh!
And don't... don't forget about the Unrivaled Fresh Fruit...
Water from Vanarana too! Soup with "the taste of happiness" can only be made with the best water!
Aralila, Nara have a incantation to find Nara in hiding. It goes like this: "Curry, curry in the air~ Hungry children it's time to come home~♪"
But what's curry?
Oh, I don't know. But I heard little Nara will come when they hear this incantation! So, you can try it if you're looking for little Nara!
Festival Utsava will have Araesha's tasty riddles, which are also sweet and fragrant! I heard that Nara like sweet and fragrant things...
So you'll love this sweet and fragrant Festival Utsava, right, Nara?
Thank you, Nara! Arakanta is so happy!
#Oh? It's Nara {NICKNAME}! We learned many lost tunes thanks to you, Paimon, and Arama.
You're well acquainted with the art of singing, right?
I'm alright, I guess...
Then please... What was the Nara phrase again? "Let me borrow your ears"... or something like that.
I think you meant "lend me your ears."
Is that how it's supposed to be? Eh, anyway, let's meet again later!
"Cover your ears?"
I'm amazing.
I might attract Whopperflowers...
#Hahaha, Nara {NICKNAME}'s really funny.
#"Even if you cover {M#her}{F#his} eyes in gloom, you can't take away the light from {M#her}{F#his} heart..."
#You're back, Nara {NICKNAME}! A Festival Utsava with you is a tale fit for songs!
Oh my, I'm so touched...
Golden Nara, we shall sing together! Please take the lead!
May this song echo in Vanarana forever!
"This is our song..."
#Yes! You will be fine, Nara {NICKNAME}! Hearing your song gives us courage to even face Marana!
*sigh* This is great...
As long as your heart emits golden and warm lights like the sun, there will always be hope!
"...Singing your song forever is the pact between you and me."
You go get some rest. I want to stay and reminisce a little.
#Thank you, Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon. Later, Ararycan will return to the bad dirty stuff, and see if anything bad happens.
#Ararycan is a good friend to Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon, forever!
Aranakin, Aranaga, my heart feels empty. Have I forgotten something?
Aragaru is "hungry" just like Nara?
What is it... Can't remember...
#This feels just like the time Nara Varuna celebrated Festival Utsava with Aranara all over again... Aranakula hasn't been so happy in a very long time, Nara {NICKNAME}. *sob*
Viparyas hate tears. Festival Utsava is a happy festival. Aranakula will play a happy song for Viparyas!
